Metadata.title: YICREDIT | Loans and Financing in France
Metadata.description: YICREDIT supports individuals and businesses in France with property loans, business financing, equipment financing, business factoring, consumer loans and debt consolidation.

hero.headline: Loans in France, explained clearly
hero.subhead: Property loans, business financing, equipment loans, consumer credit and debt consolidation. YICREDIT helps you check options, prepare documents and speak with banks.

advantages.title: Why Choose YICREDIT?
advantages.summary: We put clients first, keep pricing transparent, and provide independent, professional and objective guidance.

items.title: We Work Exclusively for Our Clients
paragraphs: At YICREDIT, we are guided by one simple principle: our clients' interests always come first.

We operate under an independent business model. We do not receive commissions from financial institutions, and our professional advice is never influenced by commercial interests. Every recommendation we make is based solely on what is best for our clients.
We believe that trusted mortgage and financing advice should be driven by expertise—not by commissions.

items.title: Transparent Pricing
paragraphs: Transparency is the foundation of trust.
At YICREDIT, all service fees are clearly explained before any engagement begins.
You always know exactly what you are paying for and why.

items.title: Independent · Professional · Objective
paragraphs: We carefully assess your financial situation, financing objectives, and available market solutions to recommend the option that best suits your needs—not the one that generates the highest commission.
Independence is our principle. Professionalism is our responsibility. Protecting our clients' interests is our commitment.

items.title: Our Commitment
paragraphs: Your interests always come before commissions.

services.title: Financing services
services.body: Property loans, business financing, equipment, factoring and debt consolidation. A first conversation helps identify the right direction.
services.moreCta: Contact us for more financing solutions

items.title: Property Loans
items.body: For a main residence, investment property or refinancing. We help clarify income, down payment, debt level and the property documents needed.

items.title: Business Loans
items.body: For startup needs, working capital or business growth. The file is prepared around the company situation, use of funds and available financial documents.

items.title: Short-Term Business Cash Flow Loan
items.body: YICREDIT short-term business cash flow loan: up to €50,000 over 6 months. Designed for temporary business financing needs.
items.alt: Short-term business cash flow financing documents

items.title: Restaurant Equipment
items.body: For restaurant openings, upgrades and equipment renewal. We can organize quotations, purchase lists and business information for lender review.

items.title: Consumer Credit
items.body: For personal projects and everyday financing needs. We help present the purpose, amount and repayment capacity in clear terms.

items.title: Debt Consolidation
items.body: For situations with several loans or heavy monthly payments. We review the existing structure and assess whether a clearer repayment setup may be possible.

items.title: Equipment and Projects
items.body: For equipment purchases, project launches or business expansion. We help gather quotations, budgets, company files and project details.
items.alt: Equipment financing documents and quotation materials

items.title: Business Factoring
items.body: For B2B companies that want to mobilize customer invoices before due date. We help organize invoices, payment terms and documents for factoring discussions.

warning.title: YICREDIT reminds you:
warning.body: A loan is a financial commitment and must be repaid. Please ensure that you have the ability to repay before entering into any credit agreement.

process.title: Service process
process.body: From first contact to channel follow-up, we handle your request through clear steps.

items.title: Contact us
items.body: Contact us by email, phone or messaging tools to understand our services, process and pricing.
items.alt: Client contacting YICREDIT for financing services

items.title: Explain the need
items.body: Share your financing purpose, amount, timing and basic situation so we can analyze possible options.

items.title: Prepare documents together
items.body: We prepare the file with you and provide timely information and follow-up guidance throughout the process.
items.alt: Client and advisor preparing financing documents together

items.title: Match channels and follow up
items.body: We move the mandate forward through our dedicated channels, follow responses and work toward the most suitable outcome.
items.alt: Financing channel matching and result follow-up
